tech_stack.description: Primary programming language for Flutter development
Cross-platform UI toolkit for mobile, web, and desktop applications
Reactive state management, dependency injection, and route management for Flutter
Implemented with proper separation of concerns using specialized controllers

custom_packages.name: pu_material
custom_packages.description: Custom UI components and styling system for the application

custom_packages.name: menu_dart_api
custom_packages.description: Data and domain layer API for menu management with use cases, models, and repositories

features.name: Home Feature
features.description: Main feature for menu browsing, filtering, and cart management with Clean Architecture implementation

components.description: UI layer with pages, views, and widgets
files: pages/home_page.dart - Main landing page with nested scroll view and sticky search bar
views/menu_home_view.dart - Menu items display with responsive grid
views/wardrobe_home_view.dart - Clothing items display
widgets/head_home.dart - Header component with cart icon and navigation
widgets/search_filter_bar.dart - Search and filtering interface with debounced input
widgets/filter_summary_widget.dart - Active filters display
widgets/responsive_items_grid.dart - Responsive grid for menu/clothing items
widgets/owner_info_widget.dart - Owner/business information display
widgets/menu_tile.dart - Individual menu item card using pu_material ProductCard

components.description: Specialized controllers implementing Clean Architecture principles
files: menu_controller.dart - Menu data management using menu_dart_api GetMenuUseCase
filter_controller.dart - Search, filtering, and categorization with debouncing
cart_controller.dart - Shopping cart management with reactive calculations
home_controller.dart - Coordinator controller integrating all specialized controllers
patterns: Single Responsibility Principle - each controller has one specific purpose
Reactive Programming - using GetX observables for state management
Dependency Injection - controllers injected via GetX bindings
Clean Architecture - separation of concerns with proper layering

components.description: Legacy monolithic controller maintained for compatibility during migration
files: menu_home_controller.dart - Original 517-line controller being gradually replaced
menu_binding.dart - Dependency injection setup for both old and new controllers

features.name: My Cart Feature
features.description: Shopping cart management and checkout functionality

files: pages/my_cart_page.dart - Cart items display and checkout interface
widgets/download_status_widget.dart - Animated status indicator for downloads/orders
getx/order_controller.dart - Order management and processing

features.name: Shared Utilities
features.description: Common utilities and helpers used across the application

files: debouncer.dart - Debouncing utility for search inputs to optimize API calls
text_normalizer.dart - Text normalization for improved search functionality with accent removal

features.name: Core Architecture
features.description: Application core with routing, configuration, and cross-cutting concerns

components.description: GetX-based routing system with page definitions and route constants

architecture_patterns.implementation: Separated presentation, business logic, and data layers
menu_dart_api package provides repository pattern for data access
Business logic encapsulated in use cases (GetMenuUseCase)
GetX observables for reactive state management
UI components structured as atoms, molecules, and organisms

testing_strategy.description: Unit tests for business logic and utilities

migration_strategy.description: Old and new controllers coexist during transition period

phases.description: Created specialized controllers with proper Clean Architecture separation
Gradually migrating UI components to use new controllers
Remove old monolithic controller once migration is complete

migration_strategy.coexistence_pattern: Both old and new controllers available via dependency injection with different tags

performance_optimizations.implementation: 300ms delay on search input to reduce API calls
Efficient text normalization for better search results
GetX observables for efficient UI updates
performance_optimizations.impact: Automatic UI updates only when state changes
Reduced network usage and faster image display

ui_components.description: Custom Material Design components with atomic design principles
components: ProductCard - Reusable card component for menu items
PuRobustNetworkImage - Robust image loading with fallbacks
Buttons - Primary and secondary button components

data_flow.description: Clean Architecture data flow with proper layer separation
flow: UI Layer (Widgets) -> Controllers -> Use Cases (menu_dart_api) -> Repositories -> Data Sources
Reactive updates flow back through GetX observables to automatically update UI

code_quality.documentation: Comprehensive inline documentation for all public APIs
code_quality.type_safety: Strong typing with null safety enabled
